data.name: Onikata Kayoko
data.description:
The "Section chief" of Problem Solver 68 and a 3rd year student at Gehenna Academy.

Unlike the other fixers, Kayoko is not one with ill intentions. However, she is often misunderstood as a delinquent simply due to natural scary facial expressions and appearance. She normally prefers to keep silent about this topic, as it likely leads to furthering her terrifying image.

Personality: From a first glance, Kayoko holds a scary demeanor and is often misunderstood as a troublemaker. In reality, she is a gentle and relaxed individual who goes along with whatever Problem Solver 68 pulls her into. Out of everyone in the club, she is shown to be the most reasonable, calm, and least destructive person as she does not actively seek to cause trouble.

Appearance: She has white hair with black bangs and a black ponytail tied to her horns. She has red eyes, pale skin and a mole in her lower neck.

Halo: Kayoko's halo has a white pentagon with three sharp points and another upside-down pentagon inside.

Uniform: She wears a black hoodie with the service logo written "Born.To.Kill" on it with red lines on the sleeves, a standard uniform underneath with brown t-shirt, pleated, plaid red skirt and black sneakers with red lines.

She carries a black bag with white crude seams hanging on her right shoulder which also has a gun holster attached to the strap.

Firearm: Kayoko uses a two-tone Heckler & Koch P30L pistol with a black suppressor. The slide and grip are chromed in silver while the receiver is colored grey. The school's name is imprinted on the left side of the receiver.

Age: 18

Birthday: March 17th

Height: 157 cm

School Year: Third Year

Club: Handyman 68

Hobby: Music CD Collection

Onikata Kayoko/Relationship:
Handyman 68:
Rikuhachima Aru: The boss of Problem Solver 68 who boasts a strong leadership outside but is a dork inside. As much as Aru tries to act cool under pressure, she frequently ends up in trouble, and Kayoko has to deal with it most of the time

Asagi Mutsuki: The most mischievous member of PS68. Mutsuki is always looking for pranking opportunities, different to Kayoko who prefers not causing trouble.

Igusa Haruka; Due to Haruka's low self-esteem, she sometimes causes problems for the club and their surroundings, leaving Kayoko with a sigh or two.

Disciplinary Committee:
Sorasaki Hina: During PS68's time in Abydos in Volume 1, Kayoko was wary of the chances the Prefect Team would come and try to arrest them, especially Hina who provides the majority of the Prefect Team's strength.

Amau Ako: Unlike the other members of PS68, Ako sensed Kayoko had some actual intelligence tied to her.
They were tasked to control Utnapishtim's Ship in Volume F.

Countermeasures Committee: Kayoko and PS68 were tasked to subdue the Foreclosure Task Force in Volume 1, but they were unable to.

Okusora Ayane: They were tasked to control Utnapishtim's Ship in Volume F.

Seminar:
Hayase Yuuka: They were tasked to control Utnapishtim's Ship in Volume F.

Supplementary Lessons Department:
Urawa Hanako: They were tasked to control Utnapishtim's Ship in Volume F.

General Student Council:
Nanagami Rin: The overseer of Operation: Occupy Atra-Hasis. While boarding Utnapishtim's Ship, Rin tasked Kayoko and some others to control the ship till they reached the Ark of Atra-Hasis.

Yuragi Momoka: They were tasked to control Utnapishtim's Ship in Volume F.
